summary: Tank sits back at the controls of the hovercraft. Trinity, heard only over the comms, tells him she needs a pilot program for a military B-212 helicopter. Tank immediately starts searching the disk drawers. When Trinity urges him to hurry, his fingers move fast over the laser disks, find the right one, feed it into Trinity's supplement drive, and punch the load commands on her keyboard.

what_changes.before: Seated and ready at the controls, awaiting a request.
what_changes.after: Actively locating and loading the B-212 helicopter pilot program for Trinity.
what_changes.evidence: Tank is immediately searching the disk drawers.

what_changes.before: Merely requesting a pilot program she does not yet have.
what_changes.after: Being supplied the program as Tank loads it into her supplement drive.
what_changes.evidence: finding one that he feeds into Trinity's supplement drive, punching the "load" commands on her keyboard.

event_hint.one_line: Tank loads the helicopter pilot program for Trinity as Neo and Trinity race to escape the building.

uncertain: Whether the program finishes loading before the scene ends.
Whether Tank is the only person physically present in the hovercraft.
